title: An interesting thing about The Bathrooms
content: A lot of people in this sub assume the dream comes from an unconscious need to pee. That may be true in some cases, but it definitely isn’t the sole cause. As a little background, I’m a recovering IV heroin addict who’s 3.5 years clean. I still occasionally have using dreams. Most often I start off in mallworld and am walking around when I realize I have heroin and a needle in my pocket, or someone gives them to me. I know I shouldn’t use it, but am almost always overtaken by the urge and try to find the nearest bathroom to shoot up. I always end up finding myself in The Bathrooms, surrounded by broken toilet stalls, overflowing/broken toilets and urinals, mold everywhere. And I’m never able to find a good spot to shoot up. So all of that to say, I do think the dream manifests due to subconscious urges, but they aren’t necessarily due to needing to pee.
